verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists Time Tracking as a first-party product feature, and its MCP server docs describe logging time entries and managing timers, so time logging exists natively. The evidence never explicitly shows entries being logged against specific tasks or projects. missing for 10: explicit documentation of logging time against individual tasks and projects (manual entry, timers on tasks, roll-up to projects), time-tracking reporting depth, independent hands-on corroboration.
